text:
Rae: Final pre-send check Quick one 1: need canonical URL, KW targets, redirect map, JSON-LD, and inbound tagging for the webinar landing by EOD. @Ivy can you take canonical + meta?

Ivy: On it. Proposed canonical: /webinars/serving-benchmarks-2026 (short, no stopwords). Meta title draft: "Serving Benchmarks: Latency vs Cost | Redwood webinar". Meta desc: "Benchmarks and practical tactics to reduce LLM inference cost while keeping latency low. Register for the live session."

Connor: I'll own redirects + Netlify PR. Avoid chains, preserve UTM params. Draft 1:1s (Netlify _redirects format):
```
# one-to-one 301s
/events/inference-2025    /webinars/serving-benchmarks-2026    301
/webinar-latency-costs     /webinars/serving-benchmarks-2026    301
/docs/old-serving-guide    /docs/inference/production-overview  301
```
I'll run a redirects-checker and include the preview link in the PR.

Marta: KW shortlist (pick H1/H2 focus): primary: ["inference benchmarks","reduce inference cost","inference latency"]; secondary: ["dedicated serving","VPC hosting","inference batching"]. Add long-tail: "webinar on serving benchmarks" into meta and OG.

Ivy: Inbound routing: use UTM_campaign=serving_benchmarks_apr26. All forms should set hidden fields: utm_campaign, source=webinar. HubSpot workflow: tag leads with webinar_serving_benchmarks, set lifecycle=MQL if attended or watched recording, assign to SDR queue for companies with >20 employees.

Marta: Structured data: Event + VideoObject + FAQ. Minimal JSON-LD snippet for VideoObject (will paste in page head):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "VideoObject",
  "name": "Serving Benchmarks webinar recording",
  "uploadDate": "2026-04-26T18:00:00Z",
  "contentUrl": "https://redwood.ai/webinars/serving-benchmarks-2026/recording"
}
```
Also add an FAQ pair: "Will there be a recording?" -> yes; "Is this relevant for private deployments?" -> yes (add to FAQ schema).

Connor: Internal linking plan: add banner CTA on /docs/inference/production-overview, inline link from /blog/serving-patterns, and mention in /benchmarks/latency-cost with anchor text "serving benchmarks webinar". Ensure rel="canonical" on any tag or archive pages that mirror the landing.

CrawlBot: Scheduled crawl: 2024502400 1: will report 404s, redirect chains >1 hop, missing canonical tags, and JSON-LD schema errors.

Rae: Great. Connor, open the redirect PR and include Netlify preview + redirect-checker output. Ivy, push meta + canonical into the page draft. Marta, paste full JSON-LD in the head and add FAQ entries. Hold the email send until CrawlBot passes. :rocket:

Connor: Will open PR by 11:30 PT. Ping me if you need the preview link.

Ivy: I'll publish the meta + canonical to the staging landing and add the UTMs to the registration form.

Marta: I'll update the content with KW placements and add the FAQ schema now.

Rae: Thanks team 1: update the launch board with owners and PR link when ready.
